title: Notes on Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson Spacetime
summary: The surface $r=\infty$ of the Kerr--Bertotti--Robinson (KBR) spacetime is not the collection of the endpoints of infinitely extended light rays, and the Coulomb type component of gravitational field strength represented by $Ψ_2$ remains nonvanishing there, indicating that this surface is not a real boundary. We construct a natural extension across this surface, which connects the exterior of one KBR region to the interior of a neighboring one and, upon iteration, produces an infinite chain of regions connected by wormhole-like bridges.
